title: Providing Housing for Single Unwed Parents and their Children
what_it_is: Providing Housing for Single Unwed Parents and their Children

sections.label: Unwed mothers maternity leave and CDA
sections.summary: Unwed mothers now have the full 16 weeks of Government-paid maternity leave and their children qualify for a Child Development Account.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Just like married mothers, unwed mothers now have the full 16 weeks of Government-paid maternity leave and their children also qualify for a Child Development Account (CDA).

sections.label: Single unwed parents median salaries
sections.summary: In 2017, single unwed parents aged 35 had a median salary of $3,100, those 36 and above $3,500, and those under 35 only $600.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, we know they have a way out there.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I also understand that in 2017, single unwed parents aged 35 have a median salary of $3,100, and those 36 and above have a median salary of $3,500.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In stark comparison, single unwed parents under 35 have a median salary of only $600 in 2017.

sections.label: Rental applications approval rate
sections.summary: Only about a third of rental applications submitted by single unwed parents to HDB are approved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Only about a third of rental applications submitted by single unwed parents to HDB are approved.

sections.label: Rental flat eligibility for single unwed parents
sections.summary: The Member requests published eligibility criteria for a specific group of single unwed parents under 35 to get a rental flat without case-by-case review; 380 have succeeded since 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: As a Member had previously raised, I, too, question the logic where a divorcee with a child, a widower with a child and even two orphaned siblings can be considered as eligible to apply for a flat from the HDB, but not a single unwed parent with his or her child.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And so, this is my first request: we should create and publish a set of eligibility criteria under which a specific group of single unwed parents under 35 years old can apply and get a rental flat without needing a case-by-case review or approval.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Since 2014, 380 single unwed parents have been successful in their application for a rental flat.

sections.label: Scheme to buy 2-room flexi flats
sections.summary: The Member requests a scheme for single unwed parents under 35 and their child to buy a 2-room flexi flat, noting 121 requests in four years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My fifth request is that we introduce a scheme for "Single unwed under 35 years old and his or her child" to buy a 2-room flexi flat from HDB similar to other schemes like the Orphans Scheme or Joint Singles Scheme where there is a set of criteria one has to fulfill to apply for a flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In the past four years, there were 121 requests from single unwed parents under 35 years old to apply for purchase of a 2-room flexi flat.

sections.label: Public housing and ASSIST priority
sections.summary: Single unweds and their children who did not qualify for public housing will now qualify and might get priority under ASSIST, and no increase in single unweds has occurred.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In fact, the single unwed and his or her child who previously did not qualify for public housing will now not only qualify for public housing but might get priority to get a flat under the Assistance Scheme for Second-Timers (ASSIST) scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I know the Government is also concerned that if more help is given to single unweds, we will have a sudden increase in the number of single unweds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But this has not been the case, since we provided the 16 weeks of maternity leave and the Child Development Account (CDA) to single unweds and their children, there has not been an increase in the number of single unweds.

sections.label: Single unwed housing measures
sections.summary: Calls for HDB website wording, letters, and a scheme for single unweds under 35 to buy 2-room flexi flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Two, specifically state on the HDB website that "Single unwed and his or her child" can apply for a rental flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Four, no longer state in letters that single unweds obtain housing based on special approvals on compassionate grounds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And five, have a scheme for single unweds under 35 years old and his or her child to buy a 2-room flexi flat from HDB.

sections.label: Rental flat appeal approved
sections.summary: An applicant's appeal for a rental flat was approved 11 days after she first contacted HDB.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: If this is the applicant and the case that I am aware of, I would like to update that her appeal for a rental flat was approved 11 days after she first contacted HDB.

sections.label: HDB rental applications volume
sections.summary: HDB receives about 7,000 public rental applications per year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: HDB receives about 7,000 public rental applications per year.

sections.label: Studying 2-room flexi demand
sections.summary: HDB will study the suggestion, bearing in mind demand for 2-room flexi flats from other applicants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: I appreciate Mr Louis Ng’s intent and understand where he is coming from.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: We will study Mr Louis Ng's suggestion carefully, bearing in mind that HDB also has to meet demand for new 2-room flexi flats from other applicants, such as singles above 35 years old and seniors who are looking to right-size or buy a short-lease flat.

sections.label: Review of single unwed touchpoints
sections.summary: HDB will review touchpoints single unwed parents encounter and consider a dedicated website section.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: First, we will conduct a comprehensive review of the various touchpoints which single unwed parents may encounter in their housing journey, from the e-applications system to our HDB branches, to improve and align our communications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Third, we will also look at the inclusion of a dedicated section in HDB’s website to address common housing queries from single unwed parents.

sections.label: Frontline services query volume
sections.summary: Staff work to improve frontline services and handle around two million queries yearly by phone, walk-ins and emails.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: They are working hard to improve their frontline services for every citizen.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: They handle a large volume of queries and feedback, around two million queries over the phone, walk-ins and emails every year.

sections.label: HDB support for single unwed parents
sections.summary: HDB will review its housing journey processes and engage each single unwed parent applicant to understand their circumstances and support their children's well-being.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: HDB will continue to improve their processes in engaging single unwed parents and in helping them find the best environment for their child to grow up in.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We will review the various touchpoints, experience and process of the housing journey for single unwed parents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: HDB will approach each and every single unwed parent who puts in an application to better understand their circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: At the heart of it, I want every single unwed parent to know that we share their desire to ensure the well-being of their children, and we will try our best to support them to this end.
